Security Services

Comprehensive Protection Across Every Attack Surface

Continuous visibility, zero trust enforcement, and automated threat defense.

Endpoint Security (EDR/XDR)

Protect your most targeted assets — endpoints and servers — with multi-layered defence against ransomware, malware, spyware, and advanced persistent threats guided by the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Next-gen antivirus with signature & anomaly detection
  • EDR — Endpoint Detection & Response (MITRE ATT&CK aligned)
  • XDR — Extended Detection spanning endpoint, network & email
  • UEFI, firmware, and pre-boot scanning
  • Sandboxing & behavioural analysis engine
CrowdStrike Falcon MS Defender XDR SentinelOne

Network Security

Defend your perimeter and internal network with next-generation firewalls, intrusion prevention, zero-trust access, and deep traffic inspection — keeping pace with the evolving threat landscape.

  • Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) with IDS/IPS & SSL inspection
  • Network Detection & Response (NDR) — internal visibility
  • Network Access Control (NAC) & 802.1X enforcement
  • Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) & Secure Remote Connectivity
  • DDoS protection, DNS filtering, and SD-WAN security
Palo Alto NGFW Darktrace NDR Fortinet Cisco ISE

Data Security & DLP

Safeguard your data across its entire lifecycle — from creation and storage through active use, transmission, archiving, and secure disposal. Full UAE PDPL and GDPR alignment built in.

  • Data Loss Prevention (DLP) — email, USB, cloud upload, messaging
  • Data Classification — Public / Confidential / Restricted tagging
  • Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) — cloud visibility
  • Encryption at rest and in transit with HSM key management
  • UAE PDPL, DIFC, ADGM, and GDPR compliance governance
Varonis DSPM Forcepoint DLP MS Purview

Security Operations (SOC)

Continuous monitoring, threat detection, and incident response capabilities — delivering 24/7 visibility into your security posture and the capability to respond before breaches escalate.

  • SIEM implementation & operations (Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar)
  • SOC-as-a-Service with SLA-backed mean time to respond (MTTR)
  • Threat intelligence integration (MITRE, ISAC, commercial feeds)
  • Incident response planning, playbooks, and tabletop exercises
  • Digital forensics, investigation, and post-incident reporting
Microsoft Sentinel Splunk IBM QRadar

Identity & Access Management

Control who accesses what across your entire organisation — from privileged administrator accounts to everyday user authentication. IAM is the cornerstone of any Zero Trust architecture.

  • Privileged Access Management (PAM) — CyberArk, BeyondTrust
  • Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) & FIDO2 passwordless auth
  • Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) with access reviews
  • Single Sign-On (SSO) & Federation (SAML 2.0, OIDC)
  • Active Directory tiering, hardening, and credential hygiene
CyberArk PAM Microsoft Entra ID Okta

Security Awareness Training

Your people are your first — and most frequently attacked — line of defence. Build a lasting human firewall through structured, role-based training aligned to real-world threat scenarios.

  • Phishing simulation campaigns with detailed cohort analytics
  • Role-based curriculum: executive, IT staff, general workforce
  • Compliance training — UAE PDPL, GDPR & data governance
  • Social engineering recognition and emergency response drills
  • Executive & board-level security posture reporting dashboards
KnowBe4 Proofpoint
Regulatory Compliance

Navigating the UAE's Data Protection Landscape

Organisations operating in the UAE face simultaneous compliance obligations across multiple frameworks. QuadWise Technologies assesses your data posture, identifies gaps, and implements the technical and procedural controls required to meet each framework's obligations.

UAE PDPL
Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 — covers all personal data involving UAE residents and sovereign data handling.
DIFC DP Law
Law No. 5 of 2020 (amended by Law No. 1 of 2025, effective July 2025) governing DIFC financial entities.
ADGM DP 2021
Comprehensive regulations governing Abu Dhabi Global Market incorporated entities and data transfers.
GDPR Alignment
Full operational alignment for organizations processing personal data of European Union residents or global clients.

Data Protection Across the Full Lifecycle

Lifecycle Stage What Happens QuadWise Protection Layer
Creation Data generated, entered, or received Classification, access controls, encryption at creation
Storage Saved on devices, servers, or cloud Encryption at rest, DSPM, access governance and monitoring
Active Use Data accessed, processed, or shared DLP policies, MFA enforcement, audit logging
Transmission Data moves across networks or to third parties Encryption in transit, network DLP, secure channels
Archiving Retained for compliance or records Retention policy management, immutable archive controls
Disposal Data no longer required Certified secure wiping and cryptographic data destruction
